modules.title: Login & Dashboard
modules.purpose: Sign in securely, see your home summary, update your profile, and read alerts.

entities.name: Login
entities.purpose: Open the app with your email or phone and password.

entities.name: Forgot password
entities.purpose: Reset your password using your registered mobile number and OTP.

entities.name: Dashboard
entities.purpose: Quick overview of tasks, leave, attendance, and announcements for your role.

entities.name: Profile
entities.purpose: View and update your personal details, password, and photo.

steps: Remove avatar uses the button on edit profile.

entities.name: Notifications
entities.purpose: See task, leave, and system alerts. Mark read or open linked pages.

steps: Open a notification → Delete button on the row (if shown).
Mark all read clears the badge without deleting history.

modules.title: People & Organization
modules.purpose: Manage staff accounts, HR records, departments, job titles, shifts, assets, and clients.

entities.name: Users
entities.purpose: Create login accounts and assign roles so people can access the system.

steps: Enter email, name, phone, password, role.
Change role, status, or contact → Save.
Prefer deactivate to block login without losing history.

entities.name: Employees
entities.purpose: Link users to HR data: code, department, designation, shift, documents.

steps: Select user, code, department, designation, shift.
Admin delete from employee detail or list action.
Import CSV available for bulk add.

entities.name: Departments
entities.purpose: Organize staff into teams. Used in reports and leave approval scope.

steps: Show Deleted → Restore to bring it back.

entities.name: Designations
entities.purpose: Define job titles and levels for employees.

entities.name: Shifts
entities.purpose: Set work hours and grace period for attendance late rules.

steps: Delete from list if no employees depend on the shift.

entities.name: Assets
entities.purpose: Track laptops, phones, and equipment assigned to staff.

steps: Mark returned instead of delete when possible.
Admin can remove asset record from edit screen.

entities.name: Clients
entities.purpose: Store customer companies linked to projects, requirements, tasks, and defects.

steps: Open Clients → open a client detail.
On the Overview tab, Save note and History (Date / Comments / Added By) work like Defects: notes plus create/edit/status and URL/DB changes.
On Requirements / Tasks / Defects tabs, use the + button to add an inline row (same pattern as Project Details).
Requirements can be created without a project; Tasks and Defects require selecting one of the client’s projects.
Edit title, status, priority, assignee, or project inline; delete with the trash icon when permitted.
Delete the client from the list or detail page.
Export list to CSV from list page.
Import clients from CSV via Import on the list page (sample file provided).

entities.name: Client URLs
entities.purpose: Version catalog of client website, demo, POS, and other URLs (separate from primary website/demo/pos fields on the client record).

steps: Open Client URLs (or client detail → Add URL).
Select client, enter version, URL, and type.
Open Client URLs → Edit on a row.
Open Client URLs → Delete on a row → confirm.

entities.name: Roles
entities.purpose: Group permissions (Staff, Admin, etc.). Pair with Permission Manager.

steps: Add role name on roles page → Save.
Then grant modules in Permission Manager.
Edit role name or description on roles page.
Delete only if no users use the role.

modules.title: Attendance & Leave
modules.purpose: Record daily punch in/out, request time off, approve team leave, and log timesheets.

entities.name: Attendance
entities.purpose: Daily punch in and punch out with optional location or face check.

steps: Admin delete from attendance edit or list.

entities.name: Apply leave
entities.purpose: Request casual, sick, WFH, or other leave types.

steps: My Leaves → open pending request → Edit.
My Leaves → Delete while status is Pending only.

entities.name: My leaves
entities.purpose: Track your leave request status.

entities.name: Team leaves
entities.purpose: Managers approve or reject team leave requests.

steps: Open request → Approve or Reject with comment.

entities.name: Leave calendar
entities.purpose: See who is off on which days.

entities.name: Timesheets
entities.purpose: Log hours against projects separately from attendance punch.

steps: Add row with project, task, hours.
Delete draft entries from timesheet list.

modules.title: Projects & Tasks
modules.purpose: Plan projects, capture requirements, assign tasks, track releases and defects, and manage status on a board.

entities.name: Projects
entities.purpose: Group work by client with dates, members, and status; portfolio matrix by delivery and timeline risk.

steps: Quadrants: Quick Wins, Major Projects, Fill-ins, Hard Slogs.

entities.name: Project Members
entities.menu: Project → Projects → project detail → Manage Members
entities.purpose: Assign users to a project and set their role (manager, lead, developer, tester, viewer, member) for access and team visibility.

steps: Open Manage Members from project detail.
Search user by email or name.
Change role in Current Members table.
Click Remove on a member row.

entities.name: Projects (Portfolio Matrix)
entities.purpose: 4-quadrant Action Priority Matrix (Effort × Impact): Quick Wins, Major Projects, Fill-ins, Hard Slogs.

steps: Filter by status, client, or search.
Open linked My Works or Task board from card.

entities.name: Requirements
entities.purpose: Store specs linked to projects and tasks.

entities.name: Tasks (list)
entities.purpose: Assign and filter work with priority and due dates.

entities.name: Tasks (board)
entities.purpose: Drag cards between Pending, In Progress, Done.

steps: Drag card or change status dropdown.

entities.name: Approvals
entities.purpose: Admin: configure multi-step approval workflows.

entities.name: Releases
entities.purpose: Track project version releases, document release note points, and email stakeholders via Reminders when a release goes live.

steps: Add release note points (what is included).
Open release → Add or edit release note points.
Use Add all fixed defects to notes for bulk changelog.
Review related defects (Add to notes per item).
Select recipients and Send notes now, or check Send when I save.
Set status to Released when live.
Open release edit → Delete (soft delete, admin).

entities.name: Defects
entities.purpose: Log, assign, and resolve bugs linked to projects, releases, and tasks.

steps: Filter by client, project, status, severity, assignee, or overdue.
List shows all non-deleted defects; use the Active switch to mark inactive (dimmed) without changing workflow status.
Open a row to view details or edit.
Optionally select Client to filter projects.
Describe issue and steps to reproduce.
Open defect → Edit status to Fixed/Verified/Closed when resolved.
Or toggle Active on the list to deactivate without changing open/fixed status.
Set due date for SLA tracking.
Review History table for all changes; optionally add a history note.
Open defect detail → Delete (soft delete, admin).

modules.title: Work Tracking
modules.purpose: Personal to-dos, daily activity logs, and performance appraisals.

entities.name: My Works
entities.purpose: Your internal to-do list with attachments, assignees, and Eisenhower priority matrix by project.

steps: Matrix uses Action Priority (Effort × Impact); drag to reprioritize.
Mark Important/Urgent on form; click project for project detail.
Export filtered list from list page.

entities.name: Daily Pulse
entities.purpose: Today-only snapshot of clients added, team leave/WFH/check-in, daily activity gaps, Second Brain history, requirements, defects, Overview today’s plan, and SPL group scores.

entities.name: Clients (Second Brain)
entities.purpose: List, Client cart, and Client URLs views inside Second Brain (same as Clients module).

steps: Use List / Client cart / Client URLs tabs.
Client cards are listed A–Z on Client cart.
Each card lists that client’s projects.
Click a project row to expand its tasks; use the open icon for full project/task pages.
Open a client detail to see Save note and History (Date / Comments / Added By), same as Defects.

entities.name: Defects (Second Brain)
entities.purpose: Browse and filter project defects inside Second Brain (same list as Defect Tracking).

steps: Filter by client, project, status, severity, assignee, or overdue.
Use the Active switch to deactivate a defect (row dims); workflow status is unchanged.
Use Add Defect / Log Defect to create; after save you return to this tab when opened from Second Brain.
Open a defect from the tab → Edit or View on the full defect screens.

entities.name: Template Tasks
entities.purpose: Create a Task from a team template catalog, or import catalog rows from CSV.

steps: Select Project (required), Team, Type, and Task, then Assigned To and optional Client / Due Date / Description.
Create Task saves one new row in the Tasks module.
Import Task opens a popup: download sample CSV, upload file, import into the template catalog (team, template_type, title).

entities.name: Daily Activity
entities.purpose: Log what you worked on each day for managers.

steps: All Activities list → Delete row (if permitted).

entities.name: All Activities
entities.purpose: Browse and export team daily activity.

entities.name: Performance
entities.purpose: HR appraisal cycles and employee self-assessment.

modules.title: Reports & Analytics
modules.purpose: Export attendance, leave, tasks, payroll, and ask the AI assistant questions.

entities.name: Reports home
entities.purpose: Jump to any report type you have permission for.

entities.name: Employee attendance
entities.purpose: Per-person present, absent, late, leave summary and export.

entities.name: Org attendance
entities.purpose: Company-wide attendance for a date range.

entities.name: Leave report
entities.purpose: Leave balances and usage.

entities.name: Task assignment
entities.purpose: Who is assigned to which tasks.

entities.name: Daily activity report
entities.purpose: Manager view of staff activity logs.

entities.name: AI Analytics
entities.purpose: AI insights on operational data.

entities.name: AI Assistant
entities.purpose: Ask questions in plain English; get tables and exports.

modules.title: Communication
modules.purpose: Chat with colleagues, send mail, post announcements, and schedule reminders.

entities.name: Chats
entities.purpose: Direct messages and group chat with file attachments.

steps: Edit or delete your own messages.

entities.name: Mail
entities.purpose: Send email via SMTP from the app.

steps: Compose new mail on mail page.

entities.name: SendGrid
entities.purpose: API bulk email (admin).

entities.name: WhatsApp
entities.purpose: WhatsApp integration (admin).

entities.name: Announcements
entities.purpose: Company news on dashboard and email.

entities.name: Reminders
entities.purpose: Scheduled email campaigns and templates.

steps: Edit schedule or template from list.
Delete reminder or template from list.

entities.name: Payslips
entities.purpose: View salary slips.

entities.name: Pay structures
entities.purpose: Salary templates per employee.

steps: Remove structure if not in use.

entities.name: Generate payroll
entities.purpose: Run payroll for a month.

entities.name: Expenses
entities.purpose: Submit reimbursement claims with receipts.

entities.name: Pending expenses
entities.purpose: Manager queue to approve or reject.

entities.name: Recruitment
entities.purpose: Job posts and candidate pipeline.

modules.title: Training & Coaching
modules.purpose: Tests, LMS courses, external training links, and coaching CRM.

entities.name: Training & Assessment
entities.purpose: Create tests and review candidate submissions.

entities.name: Master CSV import
entities.purpose: Bulk import training programs, topics, tests, questions, and assignments from one CSV.

entities.name: My Training
entities.purpose: Courses assigned to you as a learner.

entities.name: LMS Admin
entities.purpose: Create modules, topics, enrollments.

steps: Delete module or topic from admin lists.

entities.name: External training
entities.purpose: Track third-party video or URL courses.

entities.name: Coaching
entities.purpose: Coaching business: clients, sessions, billing.

modules.title: Administration
modules.purpose: System settings, permissions, email, holidays, attendance manage (admin), activity log, and database tools.

entities.name: System settings
entities.purpose: Company info, attendance rules, leave, security, AI keys.

entities.name: Permissions
entities.purpose: Tick which modules each role can access. Office Meals has six Screen permissions (My Orders, Meal Calendar, Meal Provider, Meal Settings, Meal History, All meal orders) under the Office Meals group — unchecked roles lose sidebar and screen access.

steps: Save — meals access follows Permission Manager strictly (no Super Admin bypass for Office Meals).

entities.name: Email settings
entities.purpose: SMTP for leave, task, and reminder emails.

entities.name: Activity log
entities.purpose: Audit who did what and when.

entities.name: Holidays
entities.purpose: Company holidays for attendance reports.

entities.name: Attendance Manage
entities.purpose: Admin manually add or correct employee attendance (bypasses holiday punch block).

steps: Pick user, date, check-in/out, status, notes.
Admin only; use list actions where available.

entities.name: Leave types
entities.purpose: Casual, sick, and other leave categories.

steps: Soft delete; restore from Show Deleted.

entities.name: API integrations
entities.purpose: Store Twilio, Azure, and other API keys.

entities.name: Database manager
entities.purpose: Schema tools and saved queries — use with care.

entities.name: Super Admin
entities.purpose: Elevated system tools.

modules.title: Engagement & Rewards
modules.purpose: Earn points for daily work, share knowledge, and recognize colleagues.

entities.name: My Rewards
entities.purpose: See your points, level, and recent awards.

entities.name: Leaderboard
entities.purpose: Compare monthly points with colleagues.

entities.name: Reward Rules
entities.purpose: Configure reward point rules for activities.

steps: Set category, name, points, and save.
Click Edit on a rule row.
Click Delete on a rule row.

entities.name: Reward Categories
entities.purpose: Manage categories used by SPL rules and activity forms.

entities.name: Send Cheer
entities.purpose: Recognize a colleague with peer points.

entities.name: Submit Reward Claim
entities.purpose: Lead/Admin: submit delivery, innovation, social, and other approval-based activities for team members.

entities.name: Reward Approvals
entities.purpose: Approve, reject, edit, or delete pending point claims.

steps: Click Edit (pencil) to change notes/points and Save.
Or Approve / Reject from the row actions.
On a pending row, click Delete (trash) and confirm.

entities.name: Office Closing Checklist
entities.purpose: Daily closing checklist submission (+30 points).

entities.name: Reward Rules (admin)
entities.purpose: Configure automatic point rules and manual grants.

steps: Set trigger event, points, and conditions.
Disable rule from edit screen (set Active = No).

entities.name: Knowledge Base
entities.purpose: Publish how-to articles; earn points when published.

entities.name: Helpdesk
entities.purpose: Raise and resolve internal support tickets.

steps: Manager: assign and set status Resolved.

entities.name: Events
entities.purpose: Company workshops and town halls calendar.

steps: Edit event details from admin list.

entities.name: Certifications
entities.purpose: Submit external certs for manager approval and points.

steps: Enter cert name and evidence URL.
Manager approves or rejects from list.

entities.name: Customer Feedback
entities.purpose: Log structured client feedback linked to projects.

modules.title: Office Meals
modules.purpose: Order breakfast and lunch, manage the meal calendar, provider counts, change requests after cut-off, and org-wide order reports.

entities.name: My Orders
entities.purpose: Order today's breakfast (0–3 plates) and lunch (none / half / full tiffin). Auto-saves. Tomorrow is preview only. After cut-off, request a change for provider approval.

steps: See Today and Tomorrow on one page.
Lunch: pick No / Half tiffin / Full tiffin.
After lock: use Request change if you need a different order.

entities.name: Meal Calendar
entities.purpose: Plan which dates have breakfast and lunch; optional menu notes. Can auto-publish dashboard announcements.

entities.name: Meal Provider
entities.purpose: Daily plate/tiffin counts after cut-off, approve or reject employee change requests, export CSV.

steps: Approve or reject pending change requests.

entities.name: Meal Settings
entities.purpose: Cut-off times, max breakfast plates, weekly menu template, email notifications, dashboard announcement toggle.

steps: Set provider contact and dashboard announcement toggle.

entities.name: Meal History
entities.purpose: Audit log of order changes (who changed what and when).

entities.name: All Meal Orders
entities.purpose: Org-wide roster: every employee's breakfast and lunch order for a selected date.

steps: Optionally show only employees with orders.

entities.name: Permissions (Office Meals)
entities.purpose: Assign six Screen permissions per role. Unchecked roles cannot see Office Meals in the sidebar.

steps: Provider: tick Meal Calendar + Meal Provider.
Admin: tick all screens or All meal orders.

modules.title: Sales — Business Assessment
modules.purpose: Run the Business Assessment ROI calculator from Sales — fully client-side, no server save.

entities.name: Business Assessment
entities.purpose: Open the ROI assessment tool to model leakage and savings for a prospect. Calculations stay in the browser.

steps: Fill assessment sections (workforce, inventory, billing, sales, purchase, owner time).
Review sticky ROI summary at the bottom.
Use Open full screen if you need a larger workspace.

modules.title: Sales — Subscription Builder & Proposals
modules.purpose: Build ElintOm subscription proposals and download or re-export saved proposal files.

entities.name: Subscription Builder
entities.purpose: Configure plan, industry, country, and chargeable add-ons, then preview or export a client proposal.

steps: Set client name/business and add-on quantities.
Use Preview Proposal, or Export as PDF / Excel / Word.

entities.name: ElintOm Proposals
entities.purpose: Browse saved proposals and export each file as PDF, Excel, or Word.

steps: Review client, business, creator, and date columns.
Use Export → PDF, Excel, or Word (DOC) for a row.
Excel/Word need a proposal re-saved from Subscription Builder if the HTML source is missing.
